build_recipe.rationale: The successful state-changing commands are preserved in execution order. The pipeline installs core dependencies (pydantic, tenacity, openai, pytest, torch, diffusers, pillow, numpy, decord, requests, aiohttp, einops, rotary_embedding_torch, transformers, torchvision), fixes import path issues in generate_transition.py, corrects sys.path manipulation in SEINE modules to use absolute paths instead of dynamic path resolution, creates pyproject.toml with explicit package discovery to allow editable install, performs the editable install, and patches LLMConfig validation fields (api_key and api_type) in test files to use placeholder values that pass pydantic validation. All read-only inspections, version checks, and ephemeral environment variables are excluded. The final pyproject.toml with [tool.setuptools.packages.find] was used because the first attempt without it failed with 'Multiple top-level packages discovered in flat-layout'. The sys.path fixes were applied in two passes: first replacing the path construction logic, then adding missing quotes around the absolute path.
